title: The Unmapped Reef Where Testimony Ends and the Stone Begins

features.name: reef-lattice
features.desc-on-touch: The stone structure of the reef rendered as wireframe: mathematics the ocean has been solving for centuries without witness.

features.name: testimony-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where the sailor's voices settle and go silent; the pool is where human language learned it cannot go deeper.

features.name: chart-that-stops
features.desc-on-touch: A glyph carved with navigation marks that become less and less certain, ending in uncertainty, ending in silence, ending in stone.

features.name: pressure-tower
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of immense weight climbing from below; each stone a compression of millennia; the pressure that shapes all testimony into silence.

features.name: boundary-creature
features.desc-on-touch: A sprite at the edge where witness becomes geology; it moves between languages, translating what humans knew into what stone knows.

features.name: gateway-arch
features.desc-on-touch: The threshold between the charted world and the stone's own deep record; the last arch before you cease to be a witness.

inscription: here the testimony stops, and the stone takes over the work of remembering

file.name: Uncharted_Reef_Testimony_Fragment.mp3
file.note: Sailors describing the reef; halfway through the voices corrupt into the sound of water pressure and stone settling, one language replacing another
